ships.transitingNote: ships.transiting is the half-hour rollup written at countedAt; /status shipsTransiting recounts live and drops first-fix hulls, so the two can differ slightly.
ships.strandedNote: `stranded` counts vessels seen holding position within the last hour, including ones at berth working cargo at regional ports such as Dubai and Abu Dhabi; a vessel with a stale AIS fix is left out and counted separately (see aisStaleFixInZone on /status), not folded into stranded. `strandedOffshore` excludes vessels within 25km of a working port and is the narrower figure the site's own narrative uses.
